$description: UmrahHaji design tokens - single source of truth. Two layers: `primitive` (raw ramps and scales) and `semantic` (intent, split into `light` and `dark` modes). Every contrast ratio quoted in a description is a measured WCAG 2.1 value, generated alongside the token. Typography is intentionally absent pending the font decision.

primitive.$description: Layer 1 - raw palette and scales. Never reference these directly in a component; always go through the semantic layer so theming keeps working.

teal.$description: Primary brand ramp. Base is teal-500 #14958A.

orange.$description: Secondary brand ramp. Base is orange-500 #F17824.

neutral.$description: Cool slate ramp. neutral-950 #0B1220 is the dark-mode canvas.

amber.$description: Warning ramp. Deliberately distinct from the brand orange.

spacing.$description: 4pt grid. The 2px step is a half-step for optical nudges only.

elevation.$description: Web box-shadow ladder, tinted with neutral-950. Tuned for light surfaces; dark mode leans on bg.surface steps instead.

border-width.$description: Stroke widths. 1.5px is the focus-ring / selected-state weight.

z-index.$description: Stacking order. Gaps of 100 leave room to slot layers in later.

font.$description: Font families and weights. Both faces are SIL Open Font License 1.1, so they may be embedded in iOS and Android binaries. Self-hosted from assets/fonts - never loaded from the Google Fonts CDN.

latin.$description: Primary face. Covers Malay, English and all Latin UI text.

arabic.$description: Secondary face for du'a, surah names and inline religious terms. Falls back to the Latin face so mixed runs stay readable.

weight.$description: Noto Naskh Arabic ships only 400 and 700; the intermediate weights are Latin-only.

semantic.$description: Layer 2 - intent. This is what components consume.

tertiary.$description: 4.76:1 on bg.surface, 4.55:1 on bg.canvas. Body-size minimum.

disabled.$description: 2.56:1 - below AA by design; WCAG exempts disabled controls.

brand.$description: 7.20:1 on white. The only teal allowed for body text.

accent.$description: 5.82:1 on white. The only orange allowed for body text.

on-accent.$description: Dark on action.secondary.default orange-500 - 6.64:1. Never white here (2.82:1).

surface-raised.$description: Same fill as surface; separate it with elevation-2 or higher.

muted.$description: Quiet fills: chips, skeletons, disabled tracks.

default.$description: Standard decorative divider and card outline (1.23:1 - decorative only).

strong.$description: 4.76:1 on white - clears the 3:1 UI-component minimum, so this is the token for input and control outlines.

typography.$description: Composite text styles, flattened into leaf tokens so each field becomes its own custom property. Three scales - web, mobile and arabic - plus numeric styles that force tabular figures. Sizes are px; line heights are unitless multipliers.

display-l.$description: Landing hero only. One per page.

body-l.$description: Lead paragraphs. Keep to 60-75 characters per line.

body-m.$description: Default body copy. Keep to 60-75 characters per line.

overline.$description: Eyebrow labels above headings. Always uppercase.

button-lg.$description: Line height 1 - buttons are centred by padding, not leading.

mobile.$description: Native iOS/Android scale. Tighter than web, but body copy never drops below 15px.

body-m.$description: Floor for body copy. The audience is 30-60 and often reads without reading glasses - never go below 15px.

body-s.$description: Metadata only. Never a full paragraph.

arabic.$description: Measured calibration: Plus Jakarta Sans cap-height is 0.745em and Noto Naskh Arabic's alef is 0.671em, so Arabic needs roughly 1.11x the Latin size to look optically equal. These sizes encode that - 18px Arabic pairs with 16px Latin body, 20px with 18px.

lg.$description: Long du'a passages. Pairs with 20px Latin.

md.$description: Short ayat. Pairs with 18px Latin body-l.

sm.$description: Inline religious terms. Pairs with 16px Latin body-m.

title.$description: Surah names. Note: Noto Naskh Arabic's own line box is 1.703em (ascent 1069 + descent 634 per 1000upm), so a 1.7 multiplier is a hair under the font's natural height. Fine for the single line a surah name occupies; raise to 1.8 if a title ever wraps with vowel marks.

numeric.$description: Prices sit in card grids and breakdown tables, so digits must be equal width. Plus Jakarta Sans is strongly proportional by default - its '1' is 371 units against '0' at 732 - and only 'tnum' fixes that, pinning every digit to 600 units. Verified by scripts/verify-numerals.mjs against the shipped subset fonts. Note that 'lnum' is inert: the font has no oldstyle figures, so its defaults are already lining. It is declared for portability if the face is ever swapped.

price-lg.$description: Hero price on a package card.

price-md.$description: Price in a list row or compact card.

table.$description: Breakdown table cells. Right-align the column.

measure.$description: Line-length guard rails for body copy, in ch units.

min.$description: Below this, ragged lines and hyphenation get distracting.

base.$description: Default max-width for a body text column.

max.$description: Hard ceiling. Past this the eye loses the next line.
